title: Scope cutover rehearsal engine census to its isolated target
outcome: Keep rehearsal process checks confined to their isolated target so unrelated or concurrent Node engines do not spuriously refuse a rehearsal, while live cutover retains its conservative machine-wide consumer census.
acceptance: A rehearsal does not refuse solely because another isolated rehearsal engine or unrelated Node process exists; ambiguous in-scope processes still fail closed.
The live Consumers census retains its conservative handling of other engines and unreadable process scope.
Regression coverage exercises isolated concurrent rehearsal targets and the public PowerShell rollback entry.
